reasons_add: Islahi includes shrines among the baseless objects worshipped.
Islahi says their claim that God made these objects His partners has no divine statement or proof.
Islahi says God alone controls sustenance.
Islahi explicitly directs people to ask God for provision.
Islahi says associating partners with God is ingratitude to the giver of everything.
Islahi adds that the idols will be useless to people when they are raised and returned to God.
